definitions.short: a stumbling-block , but only figuratively ( fall , enticement [idol])
definitions.full: H4384. makshelah מַכְשֵׁלָה noun feminine 1. overthrown mass . 2 stumbling-block ; — 1 figurative of kingdom Isa 3:6 . 2 plural הַמַּכְשֵׁלוֺת Zeph 1:3 stumbling-blocks = idols (compare מִכְשׁוֺל 2c ), but rather dubious; We thinks a gloss. Schw ZAW x. (1890), 169 reads וְכִשַּׁלְתִּי and I will cause the wicked to stumble. I. כשׁף (√ of following; compare Arabic cut off, cut up , Syriac to pray (literally probably to cut oneself , see 1Kin 18:28 ): so Rs J Phil. xiv. 125, 126 Nö ZMG 1886, 723 ; according to RS כֶּשֶׁף is properly herbs etc. shredded into a magic brew).
